analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5312, up 0.0050 from the stated 0.5262 comparison. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.545, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.570, Electronics 0.435, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.575. Electronics remained unchanged at 0.435. The result supports retaining the revised reduction for further experiments, but does not establish causality or separate the effects of recency weighting and per-history normalization. No test metrics were available.
code_summary: Changed only ConvRec.training_loss reduction: retain the positive plus 128 negatives cross-entropy objective, weight valid targets by backward supervised-position distance with a ten-position half-life, normalize weighted losses within each history, then average nonempty histories. Accumulation uses float32 scatter_add; empty batches return a differentiable zero. Architecture remains 96-dimensional item embeddings, eight causal residual convolution blocks with dilations 1/2/4/8 repeated twice, two-head causal attention with jointly learned relative-distance bias, layer normalization, dropout, and learned item scoring bias. Training configuration, validation selection, routing, and predictor writer remain unchanged. Each category trains from scratch and inference loads exactly one selected checkpoint, without ensembling or checkpoint averaging.
